mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tt_action_job (tenant_id, definition_id, instance_id, transition_id, definition_control_generation, parent_action_job_id, redrive_no, handler_key, action_key, execution_mode, schema_version, target_type, target_id, payload_json, payload_hash, available_at, expires_at, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_attempt_at, lease_owner, lease_until, execution_token, outcome_code, outcome_summary, completed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{definitionId}, #{instanceId}, #{transitionId}, #{definitionControlGeneration}, #{parentActionJobId}, #{redriveNo}, #{handlerKey}, #{actionKey}, #{executionMode}, #{schemaVersion}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{payloadJson}, #{payloadHash}, #{availableAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{maxAttempts}, #{nextAttemptAt}, #{leaseOwner}, #{leaseUntil}, #{executionToken}, #{outcomeCode}, #{outcomeSummary}, #{completedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tt_action_job WHERE action_job_id = #{actionJobId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM tt_action_job WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, action_job_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE tt_action_job SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, execution_token = #{executionToken}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE action_job_id = #{actionJobId} AND status IN ('READY', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND attempt_count < max_attempts

UPDATE tt_action_job SET status = 'CANCELLED', outcome_code = #{outcomeCode}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, execution_token = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE action_job_id = #{actionJobId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND execution_token = #{executionToken}

UPDATE tt_action_job SET status = #{status}, outcome_code = #{outcomeCode}, outcome_summary = #{outcomeSummary}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, execution_token = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE action_job_id = #{actionJobId} AND execution_token = #{executionToken}

UPDATE tt_action_job SET status = 'RETRY_WAIT', outcome_code = #{outcomeCode}, outcome_summary = #{outcomeSummary}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, execution_token = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE action_job_id = #{actionJobId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND execution_token = #{executionToken}

UPDATE tt_action_job SET status = 'READY', attempt_count = GREATEST(attempt_count - 1, 0), outcome_code = #{outcomeCode}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, execution_token = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE action_job_id = #{actionJobId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND execution_token = #{executionToken}

UPDATE tt_action_job SET status = 'EXPIRED', outcome_code = #{outcomeCode}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, execution_token = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE action_job_id = #{actionJobId} AND status IN ('READY', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= #{now}
mapper.select: SELECT action_job_id FROM tt_action_job WHERE status IN ('READY', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND (available_at IS NULL OR available_at <= #{now}) AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY next_attempt_at ASC, available_at ASC, action_job_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT action_job_id FROM tt_action_job WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < UTC_TIMESTAMP() ORDER BY lease_until ASC, action_job_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE tt_action_job SET status = 'RETRY_WAIT', next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, execution_token = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE action_job_id = #{actionJobId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND execution_token = #{executionToken} AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < UTC_TIMESTAMP()

UPDATE tt_action_job SET status = #{status}, outcome_code = #{outcomeCode}, outcome_summary = #{outcomeSummary}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, execution_token = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE action_job_id = #{actionJobId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND execution_token = #{executionToken} AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < UTC_TIMESTAMP()

UPDATE tt_action_job SET status = 'CANCELLED', outcome_code = #{outcomeCode}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND status IN ('READY', 'RETRY_WAIT')

UPDATE tt_action_job SET status = 'CANCELLED', outcome_code = #{outcomeCode}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE definition_id = #{definitionId} AND status IN ('READY', 'RETRY_WAIT')
